notes: Statements prepared under PRC Accounting Standards for Business Enterprises (CASBE), direct-method cash flow. Operating cash inflows also include government subsidies of 19,600,017 and tax rebates of 12,073,925 (both lower paidOut; not adjusted). financeReceivablesInOCF left null: the statement does not show whether auto-finance receivables move through 'operating receivables'.
